articles.summary: The Social Charging Index melody_admin Tue, 09/01/2026 - 12:04 Image New global research from Vontier and Driivz found that 91% of EV drivers would go out of their way for a recommended charger, revealing a 'social layer' now shaping EV charging decisions. The survey of more than 3,000 EV drivers found that nine in ten EV drivers will detour to reach a charger someone else vouched for, and 76% would avoid a charging network entirely based on a warning from friends and family. Learn about how recommendations are now routing traffic. File Document World EV Day Survey.pdf Document Type Report
